PDF A Mixed Reality Framework for Interactive Realistic Volume Rendering ...
We develop an MR visualization framework that can support inter-active realistic volume rendering and integrated it into a prototyping MR system. This MR system can display high-quality volume ren-dering effects that synchronously reflect dyanamic illumination of surrounding environment in real time.
